caption: The drawing depicts a single brass or gold-colored lamp with a curved connecting tube and an ornate top section. The lamp features a rounded, multi-tiered base that sits flat on the surface and supports a thin, curved arm extending upward and to the right. The arm attaches to a bulbous, rounded oil reservoir with a decorative ridge around its middle. Above this is a cylindrical section adorned with a decorative, crown-like metal band containing teardrop-shaped cutouts, and a round knob or button near its center for adjusting the wick. The wick protrudes slightly from the top center. The background is a plain, light beige or cream color with some minor imperfections or specks visible, and there are no other objects or elements included in the composition. The coloring is rendered to give a metallic sheen with shading to suggest a three-dimensional form.
title: Combination Peg Lamp/Candleholder
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
